remarks: PRESENT OFFERS BY NOON MONDAY, 8/4. Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac just minutes from town, this well-maintained contemporary colonial offers the perfect blend of comfort, style and convenience. Set on a beautifully landscaped half-acre lot with mature plantings, this house has privacy while remaining close to shopping, restaurants, commuter routes and local amenities including town tennis courts and ball fields. Inside the open floor plan is both functional and inviting, featuring hardwood floors throughout the main level. A sunny three season room with vaulted ceiling provides a serene space to relax, while the dramatic two story family room with fireplace creates a warm, welcome hub for gatherings. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the living spaces, ideal for modern living and entertaining. Upstairs the primary bedroom suite has a walk-in closet with custom shelving. The full unfinished basement provides an excellent potential for finishing which would be perfect for a playroom, gym, or home office. Additional highlights include a two-car attached garage, city water, sewer, and a fully automatic generator. The driveway is paved with Belgium block edging. Enjoy the outdoors from the deck overlooking a peaceful backyard retreat. This conveniently located move-in ready home delivers timeless design with today's comforts in a prime location.
